summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Auro Products billing app. 16/16 backend pytest cases pass (auth, shops CRUD + search + district filter + districts, entries with waste=208.33 for qty 2500, invoices with totals 40000/3600/3600/47200 & AP invoice_no, dashboard stats/reminders, waste analytics, settings persistence). Frontend Playwright validated: login (with error), sidebar nav, dashboard (149 shops + reminders + urgency ordering), Shops list/search/district filter/pagination/add-shop modal, BoxEntry live waste calc 208.33 + save flow, GST Invoice create producing AP604 with correct totals, InvoiceView rendering full GST tax invoice (Auro Products, GSTIN 33AITPM1982E1Z1, HSN 4819, CGST/SGST 3600 each, Total 47200, amount in words, Print button), Waste Analytics 2 recharts SVGs, Calendar month grid + prev/next nav (testids cal-prev/cal-next), Settings phone edit persists after reload.

issues: Emergent dev tool injects <span> children inside <option>, generating a React DOM hydration warning in console (`<span> cannot be a child of <option>`). Cosmetic only, does not affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: Calendar page uses testids `cal-prev`/`cal-next` while the review-request spec mentioned pattern `*-prev/next`. Existing IDs work but naming is inconsistent with the rest (`shops-pager-prev` etc.). Non-blocking.
server.py `seed_admin` uses non-lowercased ADMIN_EMAIL when reading from env but lowercases the compare — value lower()ed before lookup which is fine. OK.
server.py CORS `allow_credentials=True` with `allow_origins='*'` from default env is technically invalid per CORS spec; production CORS_ORIGINS must be explicit. Currently allow_origins is `['*']`.

server.py stores invoice_date as ISO string; range filtering with `$gte`/`$lte` on ISO strings works but appending '+T23:59:59' only when end supplied is brittle across timezones. Works for current tests.
Settings PUT accepts full SettingsModel; safer to validate/partial update, but not required.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 149 TASMAC shops and admin user on startup. Test suite creates & deletes TEST_9999 shop, an entry, and an invoice (AP604 counter increments; invoices left over from create-invoice E2E remain but grand_total 47200 is correct).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers auth, shops CRUD/search/filter, entries waste calc, invoices totals, dashboard stats, analytics, settings persistence. Frontend testids validated: login-*, nav-dashboard/shops/box-entry/invoices/waste/calendar/settings, shops-search-input, shops-district-filter, add-shop-button, save-shop-button, shop-field-*, entry-shop-select (native <select>), entry-quantity-input, waste-calc-output, save-entry-button, entries-table, invoice-modal, invoice-shop-select, invoice-qty-input, invoice-rate-input, create-invoice-button, view-invoice-<no>, print-invoice-button, cal-prev/cal-next (NOT calendar-prev/next), setting-<field>, save-settings-button, *-pager-prev/next/page-N. E2E invoice creation navigates to /invoices/:id after success. `<option>` DOM warnings are emergent-injected only.
